approach: CXA-F020 adds Sprint Burndown with Earning Rate Tracking, reusing the existing pure-analytics metrics seam from CXA-F018. Evidence: Sprint state lives at crates/application/src/state/work.rs:140 (Sprint { number, goal, started_cycle, length_cycles, committed: Vec<TicketId>, started_at }) and CycleScore at work.rs:93 carries per-cycle cost_usd and shipped; sprint.rs already has 'how many committed tickets have shipped' (sprint.rs:250) but no per-day remaining curve and no value-per-dollar metric — that is the gap F020 fills. Architecture decisions (Clean/Hexagonal): (1) Add a new cohesive pure module crates/application/src/burndown.rs — one bounded unit per file per house rules; it exposes pure functions over &ProjectState returning serializable structs, NO IO (safe for hexagonal_gate.rs). (2) Earning rate is defined explicitly as delivered value per dollar = cumulative shipped tickets / cumulative metered USD cost over a window (current sprint since started_at via CycleScore.at timestamps between started_at and now; plus lifetime using state.spend.total_cost_usd), because nothing in the codebase tracks a value-per-spend metric today. Burndown points are derived by intersecting committed TicketIds with state.history DeployRecords/ticket statuses so each completed committed ticket is one step-down on the remaining-work line against time. (3) Presentation layer stays thin: add GET /api/projects/:pid/metrics/burndown to mod.rs routes AND openapi.rs — both required by openapi_routes_gate test (this gate demands every service route be documented). No service split: this stays in the modular monolith alongside /metrics/summary and /metrics/trends; it has no independent scale/deploy need. Non-functionals: read-only analytics endpoint, no authz change beyond existing project-scoped authn on these routes; returns RFC3339 points + spend figures (already-metered numbers, not secrets); failure mode is benign empty response when no active sprint; observability reuses existing route logging. Concrete plan: implement burndown.rs computations + serializable DTOs -> wire handler in status.rs calling them -> register route in mod.rs and document in openapi.rs -> add a Burndown card to web home.js consuming GET metrics/burndown -> tests.
alternatives: (1) Extend metrics_health.rs with burndown functions instead of a new file — REJECTED because house rule mandates one cohesive unit per file; metrics_health is already CXA-F018's digest module and mixing burn logic there bloats an unrelated bounded context past its seam. The new named unit 'burndown' deserves its own file with its own tests. (2) Persist daily remaining-work snapshots into state/history during sprint rollover to make burndown trivial at query time — REJECTED as over-engineering for this ticket and a data-model change requiring migration/migration risk plus touching the rollover write path under hexagonal gates; deriving points purely from existing history/ticket statuses satisfies acceptance criteria with zero data changes and no migration needed. (3) Add earning-rate as a lifetime-only denominator using only state.spend.total_cost_usd — REJECTED because it drops the current-sprint signal that makes burndown+earning actionable together; filtering CycleScore.cost_usd/shipped within [started_at, now] gives both sprint and lifetime windows cheaply from already-structured data.
api_contract: GET /api/projects/:pid/metrics/burndown returns {"active_sprint":{"number":u32,"goal":string,"started_at":rfc3339,"committed_total":u64},"points":[{"at":rfc3339,"remaining":u64,"done":u64}],"earning_rate":{"window":"sprint"|"lifetime","shipped":f64,"cost_usd":f64,"value_per_dollar":f64}}. New route added to mod.rs router AND documented in openapi.json to satisfy openapi_routes_gate.
data_changes: None — read-only derivation from existing ProjectState fields (Sprint.committed/started_at, CycleScore.at/cost_usd/shipped, DeployRecords in history for done-timestamp mapping). No schema or migration changes.
test_plan: (1) Unit tests on burndown::compute over ProjectState struct literals covering: empty/no-active-sprint returns null earning_rate + empty points; monotonic remaining decrement as commits complete within window; earning-rate math shipped/cost for sprint window vs lifetime using total_cost_usd edge cases incl. zero-cost division guard; cross-window exclusion of cycles outside [started_at, now]. Pure-function tests require no IO fixture — satisfies hexagonal_gate by construction. Add crate-level integration test following agent_cycle_metrics_dashboard pattern asserting GET /metrics/burndown shape against a seeded store snapshot, exercising mod+openapi registration so openapi_routes_gate passes.
